step.banking_lender_complaint: Write to your bank or lender first. Keep the reply, or the date if they stay silent. RBI will only take your case after 30 days.
step.banking_wait_30_days: You have written to the lender. Wait for their reply or for 30 days to pass. Then you can go to the RBI.
step.broker_complaint_first: Complain to the broker or company first. Keep their ticket number and reply.
step.builder_check_maharera: Check that your builder's project is registered with MahaRERA. Note its registration number.
step.builder_check_rera_registration: Check that your project is registered with your state's RERA. Free advice can help you find the right office.
step.call_1930_now: Call 1930 right now. Then tell your bank in the same hour. Do not wait to collect papers.
step.civic_report_and_note_ticket: Report the problem with a photo and the exact place. Note the complaint number you get.
step.consumer_file_ejagriti: Your written complaint got no answer. You can now prepare your case for the Consumer Commission on e-Jagriti.
step.consumer_gro_letter: Write to the company's Grievance Officer first. Keep the ticket number and the date.
step.cyber_harassment_save_evidence: Save screenshots, links and dates before anything is deleted. Do not reply to the person.
step.deposit_notice_15d: Send your landlord a written notice asking for the deposit back. Give 15 days. Keep a copy and the post receipt.
step.govt_apply_then_grievance: Keep your application number and date. If the office is late, file a grievance online.
step.govt_excluded_get_advice: The government grievance portal does not take this kind of matter. Get free legal advice instead.
step.insurance_write_to_gro: Write to the Grievance Officer of your insurance company first. Keep the written acknowledgement.
step.legal_aid_screener: Answer a few questions to see if you can get a free lawyer.
step.lost_mobile_block_and_report: Ask your mobile company to block your SIM. Then report the lost phone with its IMEI number.
step.mrp_ask_refund_and_photo: Take a clear photo of the price tag and the bill. Ask the shop in writing to return the extra money.
step.neighbour_letter_then_mediation: Write a polite letter to your neighbour about the problem. At the same time, ask free legal aid for mediation.
step.other_get_free_advice: Describe your problem in a few lines and talk to a free legal adviser.
step.pf_keep_uan_ready: Keep your UAN number and your PF or pension details ready. Then file your grievance.
step.police_civil_or_criminal: First check: is this a crime, or a money or property dispute? Police take crimes. For money disputes, use the civil route.
step.police_violence_safety: First, get to a safe place. If you are in danger now, call 112. You can report it at any police station, and you do not need to bring anything.
step.posh_internal_committee: Ask your workplace's Internal Committee for help first. You can also use SHe-Box. Your draft stays on your device.
step.wages_demand_notice_7d: Send a written demand notice to your employer. Give them 7 days to pay. Keep a dated copy.

ui.about.how.1: Understanding. Raasta reads what you describe in your own words and picks out the kind of problem. Personal details are removed first.
ui.about.how.2: Finding the place. Raasta works out your state, district and city, and your ward where we have the boundaries, so that it can match local offices.
ui.about.how.3: Choosing the route. A fixed set of rules, written from public handbooks, decides the first peaceful step, the right authority and the next steps. These rules do not use AI.
ui.about.how.4: Explaining it. An AI helper may put the result into plain language. It can only repeat facts that the rules already contain, and it cannot add links, fees or deadlines of its own.
ui.about.how.5: Acting on it. You get a checklist, a letter or form to check, a step-by-step guide and contact details. You read what Raasta prepares and send it yourself.
ui.about.how_lead: Each request passes through five stages.
ui.about.lead: Raasta helps people in India find the right authority for an everyday dispute.
ui.about.not: Raasta is not a government service, a law firm or a court. It does not file a case for you.
ui.about.who: Raasta was built by a student team for the Rotary x Rotaract Naya Bharat 2047 Code for Bharat hackathon. The team is not a company, and Raasta is free to use.

ui.disclaimer: Raasta gives procedural guidance based on public government rules. It is not legal advice.
ui.disclaimer.lead: Raasta gives procedural guidance based on public government rules. It is not legal advice.
ui.disclaimer.p1: Raasta explains which authority usually handles a kind of problem, what the first peaceful step is, which documents are often needed, and which time limits apply under the rules we have recorded.
ui.disclaimer.p2: Every case is different. Rules change, offices change their procedures, and the facts of your case decide the best route. Check details with the authority, and get advice from a qualified lawyer or free legal aid when the matter is serious.
ui.disclaimer.p3: Fees, time limits and office details come from our sources, and we show the date we last checked them. If a link or phone number does not work, please tell us through the feedback page.
ui.disclaimer.p4: Never share an OTP, PIN, password or card number with anyone who asks for it by message or call, including someone who says they are from Raasta.

ui.privacy.rights: You can ask what Raasta holds about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. You can also complain about how we handle your information. Send your complaint through the feedback page. The Grievance Officer for Raasta is the project team, reached through the feedback page.
ui.privacy.security: Pages are sent over HTTPS. We limit how often a device can send forms, and we check that forms come from this site.
ui.privacy.server: Raasta does not keep your personal details on our servers. When you describe a problem, the text is handled in memory to produce your guidance, and it is not written to a log. Letters and forms are built in memory and sent back to you.

ui.stub.terms.lead: The terms on which you may use Raasta.
ui.terms.advice: Raasta gives procedural guidance based on public government rules. It is not legal advice, and using it does not create a lawyer and client relationship. For advice about your case, speak to a lawyer or to free legal aid.
ui.terms.changes: We may change these terms. The date at the bottom of this page shows when they last changed.
ui.terms.contact: Questions about these terms can be sent through the feedback page.
ui.terms.content: Government portals, offices and phone numbers belong to the bodies that run them. Raasta lists them for your convenience and does not control them. Map data comes from OpenStreetMap contributors under the Open Database Licence.
ui.terms.intro: These terms apply when you use Raasta. By using Raasta, you agree to them.
ui.terms.law: These terms are governed by the laws of India. Any dispute about Raasta is subject to the jurisdiction of the courts in Pune, Maharashtra.
ui.terms.use: Use Raasta only for lawful purposes, for your own problem, or to help someone who has asked you to. Do not try to break into the site, overload it, or send false complaints. Do not paste other people's personal details.
ui.terms.warranty: Raasta is provided as it is. We try to keep information correct and up to date, but rules, fees and office details change. Check with the authority before you act. We are not liable for loss that comes from using or relying on Raasta.
ui.thanks.body: We have received it. We read every message.
ui.tos.feedback_note: Feedback is read by the project team.
warn.bank_zero_liability_3d: Tell your bank in writing within 3 working days. This protects you from losing the money.
warn.civil_not_police: Money and property disputes are civil matters. Police take crimes.
warn.coverage_standard: For your area we show national and state options. Local office details may be missing.
warn.cpgrams_excluded: CPGRAMS does not take RTI, court, or family matters.
warn.cpgrams_excluded_personal_family: CPGRAMS does not take personal or family disputes.
warn.cpgrams_excluded_rti: CPGRAMS does not take RTI matters.
warn.cpgrams_excluded_sub_judice: CPGRAMS does not take matters that are in court.
warn.cpgrams_no_email: CPGRAMS does not accept complaints sent by email. Use the portal.
warn.emergency_call_112: If you are in danger right now, call 112.
warn.fir_sign_in_person_3d: An online FIR must be signed in person within 3 days, or it is not taken on record.
warn.forum_exclusivity_consumer: Do not file the same complaint in two forums for the same relief.
warn.forum_exclusivity_rera: Do not file the same relief in both RERA and the Consumer Commission.
warn.free_legal_aid_survivor: Women, children and survivors of violence can get a free lawyer from the Legal Services Authority, whatever their income.
warn.irdai_verify_link: Check the IRDAI website for the current complaint link before you file.
warn.legal_aid_genuine_case: Free legal aid needs a genuine case and a short income statement.
warn.limitation_close: The time limit to file this is close. Act soon.
warn.limitation_passed: The usual time limit may have passed. Ask for free legal advice about delay.
warn.local_body_not_in_data: We do not have your local office on file yet. Check your city or state website.
warn.location_unknown: We do not know where you are. Add your city for exact offices.
warn.lost_found_info_only: The lost and found page is only for information. A false report is a crime.
warn.mrp_legal_metrology: You can also complain to the district Legal Metrology office about selling above MRP.
warn.nch_no_pause_limitation: The National Consumer Helpline does not stop the 2 year time limit for a case in the Consumer Commission.
warn.neighbour_two_tracks: Run both tracks together: a complaint to the city office, and mediation or a court order for your wall or property.
warn.never_share_otp: Never share an OTP, PIN or password with anyone. Not even with us.
warn.not_police_for_deposit: A deposit refund is a civil money matter. Police will not take it unless there was cheating or fraud.
warn.pmc_no_iframe: PMC pages open in a new tab. They cannot be shown inside another site.
warn.privacy_mode: Private mode: your story stays on your device and is not sent for AI help unless you choose.
warn.rbi_cms_blocked_30d: The RBI complaint portal is locked until 30 days after your written complaint to the lender. Filing early gets rejected.
warn.rbi_upload_10mb: RBI uploads must be under 10 MB in total.
warn.sebi_not_market_loss: SEBI does not cover losses from normal market ups and downs.
warn.shebox_posh_only: SHe-Box is only for sexual harassment at work. A false complaint can be punished.
warn.state_office_not_in_data: We do not have this office for your state yet. Free legal aid can tell you where to go.
warn.state_rera_not_in_data: We do not have your state's RERA on file yet.
warn.swachhata_sanitation_only: Swachhata is only for garbage and toilets. Use your city's own portal for roads, water and lights.
warn.wages_civil_suit_option: You can also file a civil summary suit for unpaid money. Free legal aid can help.
warn.wages_sphere_unknown: We do not know if your employer is a central or state body. Both options are shown.
warn.zero_fir: Any police station must take your complaint, even if it happened somewhere else. This is called a Zero FIR. Ask for a free copy.
why.aaple_sarkar_state: Aaple Sarkar is the Maharashtra government grievance portal.
why.banking_rbi_cms: The RBI complaint portal is free. It only accepts your case after your bank has had 30 days to reply.
why.broker_sebi_scores: SEBI SCORES takes complaints against registered brokers and companies. The company must reply in 21 days.
why.builder_conciliation: MahaRERA conciliation is cheaper and quicker. The builder must agree within 7 days.
why.builder_form_a: A formal MahaRERA complaint (Form A) is a full case with a higher fee.
why.builder_other_state_advice: MahaRERA works only in Maharashtra. Free advice can point you to your state's RERA.
why.civic_aaple_escalation_21d: If nothing happens in 21 working days, escalate on Aaple Sarkar.
why.civic_digit_direct: Your city runs an online complaint system. We can send your complaint straight to it.
why.civic_fallback_national: We could not find your city's own portal. Swachhata works for garbage and toilet problems. Check your city's website for others.
why.civic_metro_portal: Your city's own municipal portal is the right place for this complaint.
why.civic_pcmc_whatsapp: Pimpri-Chinchwad Municipal Corporation takes complaints on WhatsApp.
why.civic_pmc_whatsapp: Pune Municipal Corporation takes complaints on WhatsApp. It is the fastest way.
why.civic_state_portal: Your state's grievance portal can take this complaint and push the city office.
why.civic_swachhata_sanitation: Swachhata is a national app for garbage and toilet complaints only. It has a short deadline.
why.consumer_ejagriti: The Consumer Commission can order a refund. File it on e-Jagriti, within 2 years.
why.consumer_nch_first: The National Consumer Helpline asks the company to settle with you. It is free and fast, but it does not stop the 2 year time limit.
why.cpgrams_central: CPGRAMS is the central government grievance portal. It works for central government offices.
why.cyber_fraud_1930_first: 1930 can freeze the money fast if you call early. Then file on the cybercrime portal.
why.cyber_fraud_fir_escalation: If there is no response in 7 to 10 days, or the loss is large, go to the police in person.
why.cyber_harassment_portal: File on the national cybercrime portal. Use 112 if you are in danger.
why.deposit_dlsa_lok_adalat: The Legal Services Authority can settle it for free through mediation or a Lok Adalat.
why.deposit_police_only_cheating: You told us there was cheating or fraud. Police can take that part only.
why.deposit_small_causes: If the notice fails, the Small Causes Court hears landlord and tenant money cases.
why.deposit_tele_law_first: A deposit dispute is a money matter. Start with free legal advice and a notice.
why.govt_aaple_state: Aaple Sarkar handles delays in Maharashtra government services. The answer is due in 21 working days.
why.govt_cpgrams_central: CPGRAMS handles delays in central government services.
why.govt_cpgrams_if_central: If the office is a central government office, use CPGRAMS instead.
why.govt_excluded_advice: Free legal advice is the right place for court, RTI or family matters.
why.govt_state_portal: Your state's grievance portal handles delays in state government services.
why.harassment_police_fir: Police can register an FIR for threats and harassment online.
why.insurance_irdai: IRDAI and the Insurance Ombudsman handle insurance complaints after the insurer has had its chance.
why.insurance_nch: The National Consumer Helpline can also push the insurer to settle.
why.legal_aid_dlsa: The Legal Services Authority gives free lawyers and advice to people who qualify.
why.legal_aid_free: Free legal help from the Legal Services Authority, for those who qualify.
why.lost_mobile_form: The police lost mobile form records your lost phone. This is information only, not an investigation.
why.mrp_nch_whatsapp: Send the complaint on WhatsApp to the National Consumer Helpline. It is quick and free.
why.neighbour_dlsa_injunction: The Legal Services Authority can help with mediation and with a civil court order to stop the work.
why.neighbour_pcmc_complaint: PCMC handles construction complaints in Pimpri-Chinchwad.
why.neighbour_pmc_encroachment: PMC can act on illegal construction and encroachment. Write to the ward office too.
why.other_tele_law: Free legal advice is a safe first step when you are not sure where to go.
why.pf_epfigms: EPFiGMS is the EPFO portal for PF and pension problems.
why.police_mahapolice: The Maharashtra police portal takes complaints for crimes. A signed copy must follow in person.
why.police_other_state_advice: We do not have your state's police portal yet. Call 112 in an emergency. Free advice can guide you.
why.police_violence: Violence is a crime. The police must register your complaint. You can file it at any police station, even outside the area where it happened.
why.police_violence_other_state: Violence is a crime. Go to any police station or call 112. Tele-Law can connect you to a free lawyer to help you through it.
why.posh_legal_aid: Women can get a free lawyer from the Legal Services Authority.
why.posh_shebox: SHe-Box takes complaints of sexual harassment at work.
why.state_grievance_portal: This is your state's grievance portal for state government offices.
why.tele_law_free: Tele-Law gives free legal advice by phone or video to every citizen.
why.wages_legal_aid_no_state_office: We do not have your state's labour office yet. Free legal aid can tell you where to go.
why.wages_mahakamgar_state: The Maharashtra labour office handles wage disputes with private shops, factories and firms in the state.
why.wages_samadhan_central: SAMADHAN handles wage disputes with central government offices and central companies.
